title: config/parity.json
description: The language-parity declaration, read by scripts/kit/parity.mjs: the implementations of the repository (the one source of the language set), the profiles that group them, and the units that every implementation of a profile must hold. The facts come from the tree: the checker runs the bindings, reads the symbol snapshots and the error-code artifacts.

name.description: The name of the implementation, used by the profiles, bindings and documents.

runner.description: How a binding runs and reads its outcomes, through the output parsers of scripts/kit/test-output.mjs: go (go test -json), cargo (cargo test), node (node --test with the TAP reporter), php (PHPUnit of the Composer package of the test, TeamCity messages) and python (var/tools/bin/python3 -m unittest -v). A case is a subtest, a test named by the case, or a test method test_<case>.

roots.description: The directories that hold the implementation and its tests; the whole repository is no root.

tests.description: Globs of the test files of the implementation; each one, except a file of its support globs, must be the test of a binding.

support.description: Globs of the test-support files of the implementation: files in its roots that its tests or the testPatterns of its runner select but that hold no test, such as a Go helper that must end in _test.go. A support file is no test of a binding; a Go support file declares no function that go test runs, a cargo support file holds no test attribute, and parity-check runs each node, php and python support file once and fails when it reports a case. Each glob selects at least one such file.

command.description: The program of the runner: a path resolved against the root of the checkout when it holds a / (an absolute path stays absolute, and a path with .. may leave the checkout), else a name on PATH. Default: go, cargo, the running node, php, var/tools/bin/python3. ${NAME} is the value of NAME in the invoking environment when the bindings run.

args.description: Arguments of the program: after test for go and cargo; before the test file for node, before the PHPUnit path for php (the run of php then names the configuration of its package with --configuration <package>/phpunit.xml or phpunit.xml.dist, or --no-configuration when it has neither) and before -m unittest for python. ${NAME} is the value of NAME in the invoking environment when the bindings run.

env.description: Variables set for the runs of this implementation only, over the environment of the check. ${NAME} in a value is the value of NAME in the invoking environment when the bindings run; an unset or empty NAME is a finding of the runs of the implementation, and there is no default form.

symbols.description: The symbol snapshot of the extractor: a JSON object from each symbol id to an object with a boolean exported.

errors.description: The generated error-code artifact of the implementation and the regular expression whose first group is a code.

reason.description: Why the profile omits implementations; a profile narrower than every implementation needs it, and every run prints it.

suites.description: Globs of the shared vector files; each one must be the file of a suite unit.

comparators.description: The directories of the checks that compare the outputs of several implementations; a test there belongs to no implementation.

testPatterns.description: Globs of the test files of each runner across the repository; such a file lies in a root of an implementation of that runner or in a comparator root.

id.description: The name of the unit; the findings name a case of a suite as <id>/<case>.

cases.description: suite: the path of the case names in the file, $ followed by .<key> and [*] steps.

admit.description: suite: the key of each case object (the object that holds the name at cases) that lists the implementations which admit the case, such as "kinds". A case without the key is admitted by every implementation of the profile; an implementation that the list omits does not run the case, and every run prints it. A listed name is an implementation of the profile, a list is not empty and names each implementation once, the key is on some case, and every implementation of the profile admits some case or is excluded under R8.

bindings.description: suite: the native test of each implementation.

symbol.description: go: the test function whose subtests are the cases; cargo: the module path whose tests <symbol>::<case> are the cases.

symbols.description: api: the symbol id of each implementation in its snapshot.

nativeOnly.description: Exported symbols that belong to one implementation only, each with its reason.

exclusions.description: A unit that an implementation of its profile does not hold yet; every exclusion is a finding until it is removed.

item.description: The checklist item that removes the exclusion.

errors.description: The error-code catalog that every implementation of the profile generates.

catalog.description: The catalog file and the regular expression whose first group is a code.

languageLists.description: Lists of implementation names in other files, each equal to its profile.

pattern.description: A regular expression whose first group holds the list; its words are the names.

documents.description: The documents whose counts and lists of implementations must match a profile.

nouns.description: The words that a count of implementations precedes, such as languages or 언어.
